envelope.description: Expose effective ownership and transfer state

body.title: Expose effective ownership and transfer state
body.summary: Implement pure owner-version evaluation and the approved AMD-1 effectiveOwners result in the reducer. Separate same-root single commitments from cross-root prepared/accepted/committed reference chains; perform no transfer IO.
acceptanceChecks: A valid same-root transfer.committed with null phase refs changes the effective artifact once; a cross-root commit requires its matching phase/closure evidence.
Pending transfer retains the current committed owner; conflicting versions, cycles/forks or missing ownership proof produce explicit unresolved mappings, not destination charges.

Every new result contains typed effectiveOwners tying call/basis to effective root/artifact/version, capture owner and provenance. Grouping consumers cannot fall back to capture IDs when mapping is absent.
Replay is idempotent; no counters or original observations are copied/mutated. No root resolver, writer, lock or coordinator is introduced.

tests.name: src/workflow/usage/__tests__/transfer-state.test.ts: same-root single commitment, cross-root phase closure, pending/conflicting owner versions and typed effectiveOwners provenance/replay
